Decide whether the proposal deck addresses the client requirement below.

- "Covered": the slides commit to ALL parts of the requirement. Different wording is fine.
- "Partially covered": the slides commit to SOME parts, but at least one part is missing.
- "Not covered":

response.missing: The slides make no mention of providing final deliverables in both Arabic and English.
response.reasoning: The proposal lists final deliverables on Slide 10, but contains no commitment regarding the languages (Arabic and English) in which they will be provided.
